prompts.A:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: premium full-bleed portrait 4:5 campaign art plate for Slovak family home puzzle adventure Pixelkovia. Produce one finished cinematic composition, no lettering; editable advertising copy will be added later.
Input images: 1 approved brand room for warm amber / midnight blue art direction and soft painted pixel characters; 2 genuine gameplay photograph for what real shared-phone play looks like (reference only, not a customer endorsement); 3 exact approved blue cloud-headed screen-faced hero with black suit, teal tie and orange clipboard; 4 exact approved orange shield protector with cream smiling face, teal tie and cyan keyhole.
Scene: recognisable ordinary central European living room at dusk, dark blue sofa, warm shaded lamp, leafy plant, wood coffee table. Two children age 8–11 viewed candidly over shoulders, one blonde in white and one light-brown-haired, together leaning over ONE smartphone with blue tile puzzle, paper clues partly under their hands and pencil. Faces naturally partly seen from side/back, realistic anatomy, adult hand pointing from left, genuine shared concentration and delight. Family occupies middle/lower portion, not tiny. Screen should resemble actual referenced game, never futuristic holographic device.
Art direction: world-class family-game advertising, photo-real room and people with the brand's tiny painted pixel creatures integrated into the same lighting and perspective, extremely carefully art directed. Blue cloud character sits on the near-right wooden table edge, boots dangling, looking at children's phone, clipboard in lap. Orange shield character peeks around table's left edge. Both small relative to real children, richly textured, ambient occlusion and amber/cyan reflections, no sticker halos. Subtle tiny square motes trace a path from paper to phone. Nothing suggesting real game projects holograms.
Composition: 4:5 portrait (prefer 1536x1920 or similar), luxurious dark negative space upper 35% for large headline, lamp top-right leaves top-left dark and legible. Children and phone concentrated between 40% and 78% height, characters around 68–82%. Bottom 16% dark quiet room shadow reserved for editable facts and CTA. Layered foreground table, cozy background, natural shallow depth, rich detail, cohesive unbroken photographic frame.
Constraints: no readable text, no letters, no character names, no logos, no watermark, no buttons, no borders, no split photos or collage cards. Paper only partly visible generic abstract line fragments; no complete worksheet, no QR, no answers or handwritten numbers. Preserve exact character identities and original painted pixel surface, no redesign, no USB tail, no giant toys, no extra phones, no huge magical digital table. Make the atmosphere at least as polished as the room reference.
prompts.B:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: premium 4:5 portrait full-bleed background plate for a family puzzle game advertisement; no lettering or copy.
Primary request: ONE meticulously art-directed cinematic close-up of a real family playing together on a single smartphone in a warm ordinary apartment at night. The game is paper clues plus simple blue/cyan touchscreen puzzles, not a boxed board game.
Input roles: image 1 authentic gameplay phone close-up defines real hands, actual phone and blue tile UI; image 2 approved room defines midnight-blue/amber lighting and ordinary apartment; image 3 blue cloud-headed suited pixel creature defines exact identity; image 4 orange shield creature defines exact identity.
Composition: intimate side/overhead camera, large child's hands holding ONE smartphone in lower central-right area at a gentle angle, display very clear blue memory-card tile pattern like reference 1; another child next to first, their heads visible from behind near lower-left, one parent hand indicating a partly hidden printed clue on wood tabletop. Phone and fingers form the sharp subject; sofa, warm lamp, plant softly out of focus. Dark blue negative space in upper 40% for editable large ad headline; main phone extends from 43% to 80% of frame, lower 18% quiet dark amber-blue tabletop shadow for facts and CTA.
Creative integration: the exact little orange shield with teal tie and cyan keyhole sits naturally on the real phone case's upper outside edge looking at the screen, orange boots hanging over edge. It is thumb-size, no giant mascot. The exact blue cloud-headed suited character leans from behind the lower-left table edge with both little hands gripping the lip and curious screen expression. Painted soft pixel characters share the photographed warm light, realistic contact shadows and faint cyan bounce, beautifully blended as the brand's imaginary helpers. A very restrained path of tiny luminous square particles ties paper to mobile, no gigantic magic.
Style: sophisticated advertising photography mixed with reference-specific painted pixel characters, tactile real wood, natural children's hair and anatomy, cinematic contrast, clean premium composition, warm emotional authenticity, no waxy AI faces or plastic cartoon humans.
Constraints: NO text, readable letters, names, logos, watermarks, UI labels, numbers or QR codes; preserve blue memory-card shapes on screen without inventing UI copy. Paper only small cropped fragments partly covered by hands, never a complete worksheet, no answers. No separate photo cards, borders, sticker outlines, giant hands, extra fingers or phones, no holographic game, no invented new characters.
prompts.C:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: premium portrait 4:5 cinematic advertising image plate, third concept for Pixelkovia family home adventure; NO baked copy.
Input images: 1 approved brand apartment and painted pixel art style; 2 original blue cloud-headed screen-face character wearing black suit teal tie with clipboard; 3 original orange shield character with teal tie and cyan keyhole; 4 small glowing yellow square component character.
Primary scene: candid believable family treasure hunt in an ordinary warm apartment at blue hour. Two children age 8–11, blonde boy in white T-shirt and brown-haired girl in muted teal jumper, crouch together BESIDE a dark-blue sofa, one lifting the corner of a pillow while the other discovers a SMALL folded paper clue peeking beside a sofa leg. Their parent sits near them smiling and holding ONE smartphone out of focus, with navy blue screen. Lived-in room with wood floor, knitted blanket, warm lamp, framed abstract art and plant. Children inquisitive and delighted, candid side profiles, natural anatomy and proportions. Generic folded paper glimpse only, no text and no complete puzzles.
Creative storytelling: exact tiny blue cloud-headed suited screen-face hero is perched on the top of the sofa arm at right around 48% frame height, leaning forward and pointing down to clue, orange clipboard under other arm. Exact tiny yellow square glowing character peeks from behind foreground pillow. Exact little orange shield with cyan keyhole stands near sofa foot as if guarding discovered note. Preserve reference identities, original painted pixel texture, charming but not cheap plastic. Mascots physically integrated with lamp shadows and cyan reflected edge light, no sticker outlines. A few tiny blue square signal motes subtly lead our eye from foreground paper toward phone.
Art direction: extraordinary photo-real humans and real room, gently storybook atmospheric light with soft painted pixel creatures, professional international family-game campaign, rich cinematic navy/cyan/amber palette matching approved funnel, layered detailed set dressing. Completely seamless environment, no photo collage, no cards. Portrait 4:5.
Composition: upper 38% predominantly quiet dark midnight-blue wall at left/center for large editable headline; warm lamp can glow at extreme upper-right. Family searching concentrated 43–78% height, foreground orange shield near 78%; bottom 17% quiet naturally dark wood shadow for facts and CTA. Main action must read immediately at phone size.
Constraints: no text, concrete character names, labels, logos, buttons, QR codes, complete worksheets, numbers or written answers. No extra phones or giant magical props, no holograms, no fantasy fortress, no new mascot designs, no unnatural extra limbs.

Lighting: warm amber rim light from top-right, soft blue reflected light from bottom-left, maintain reference painted pixel style, premium detailed shading, subtle glow close to stroke only.
Constraints: no text, no names, no letters, no symbols written on character or canvas, no logo, no watermark, exactly one character, no new character design. The stroke is abstract underline only and will align under a headline in layout.
